cards.summary: Causal audit (sepsis): SAFETY VETO, rule withholds indicated therapy
cards.detail:
**Strategy:** proximal (DR form), if elicited violations are below half the reference crossing.  
First-stage F = 2353 (design-specific threshold 16; use weak-identification-robust intervals below F = 104.7).  
ATE, proximal DR: -0.177 [-0.210, -0.144]; proxy-adjusted: -0.112 [-0.133, -0.091].  
Reference crossing points (design stage, DR): gamma* = 0.29, delta* = 0.23.  
Rule withholds treatment from 14% of indication-flagged patients (tolerance 10%).  
Knowledge-driven rule value (standard DR) 0.316: unverified, confounder not recorded.
